Job Description

Department: RS-407 - Content - P&E - Content Formats Location: US - Home/Remote Description Why Join DAZN? DAZN is the global home of sport, delivering premium live and on-demand coverage to fans around the world. Through our DAZN channels, we connect passionate basketball communities with the teams, players, stories, and moments that matter most. This role offers the opportunity to help shape how basketball is experienced across social media, creating engaging, social-first content that drives conversation, fandom, and community engagement around the sport. The Role As a Content Creator you will be responsible for creating and publishing engaging social-first content across DAZN social channels, helping bring the biggest moments from the sport closer to fans. This is a hands-on role requiring creativity, strong basketball knowledge, and excellent editorial judgement. Salary Range: $66,500. This is hybrid role which will be based mostly on site from our New York office. What You'll Be Doing: What You'll Be Doing Create and publish short-form content across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, and YouTube. Cover live basketball games and produce content in real time around key moments and fan conversations. Self-shoot, present, and appear on camera regularly as part of the content output. Edit high-quality vertical video content with fast turnaround times. Clip live game footage and transform key moments into engaging social content. Lead on reactive, personality-led content during live games and key basketball events. Identify trends and turn them into engaging basketball storytelling. Collaborate closely with the Social Manager and wider social team to execute content plans. Contribute creative ideas and new formats to evolve the basketball social presence. What You'll Bring: What You'll Bring Proven experience creating engaging social-first content (portfolio required). Strong passion for basketball, with extensive knowledge of basketball culture. Excellent on-camera presence and confidence presenting content regularly. Advanced skills in filming, editing, and producing content end-to-end. Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and audience behaviors. Ability to work quickly and effectively in fast-paced, live-event environments. Creative, proactive mindset with strong execution skills. Fluent English (spoken and written) essential. Benefits Benefits include access to DAZN, up to 15 days of paid time off, health benefits (including dental & eye care), a sick time package, parental leave offering, voluntary benefits (such as basic life term, personal accident and short and long-term disability covering) and a 401(k) retirement plan.
